1r5s683.description_en:
To all available contractors,
Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.
In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.
For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
1r5s683.description_zh:

特别是，我们在 [DESTINATION] 的科学家们因耗尽这些资源而不得不暂停工作。由于供应短缺，我们的常规供应商数月内无法供货，因此我们将为任何能协助补充这些物资的人提供丰厚报酬。

有关这些动物的更多信息，请参阅您日志中的《探险家的可采集物指南》。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

One of our Clips put out a kill order on a [TARGET]. Feel like making ‘em happy by taking it out?
Here’s what you need to know. The target and their escort are scheduled to pass by [LOCATION]. Looks like there’s an emission cloud nearby that can hide your ship’s sig. Wait there until you’re ready to strike.

ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = ME-01
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********
We have received word that Nicks Cantwell, long-time acquaintance and confident of Maltrox Arlington, was spotted trying to purchase a high-density mining laser, the kind frequently used in past ship-jacking attempts to strategically breach hulls. We have provided coordinates for Nicks’ last known location.
Nicks is a highly regarded munitions expert among criminal circles and often leaves a path of destruction in his wake. It is advised to bring an increased level of firepower to this encounter.
You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 差事

合约类型：集体逮捕令
合约状态：独立
授权代码 = [CONTRACTOR]

需要立即处理

*********
__背景信息__
臭名昭著的阿灵顿帮居然试图从一个修船厂中盗窃一艘伊德里斯级护卫舰，相应的，他们每个人都在这一份集体逮捕令中。这次盗窃被阻止了，那群渣滓也落荒而逃，分散躲进了黑暗中。皆是无胆鼠辈，大难临头各自飞。埃克哈特安保收到了一份对阿灵顿帮高级成员的即时赏金逮捕令。成员包括：马尔特克斯·阿灵顿，卡斯·登特，尼克斯·坎特威尔，萨姆“爱哭鬼”阿灵顿，奥斯陆·阿灵顿和莱斯·阿灵顿。
*********

我们得到消息，长期相识并对马尔特克斯·阿灵顿充满信心的尼克斯·坎特威尔被发现试图购买高密度采矿激光，这种激光在过去的几次舰船劫持事件中经常被用于战略性突破船体。我们将为你提供尼克斯的最后已知地点。

尼克斯是一名在犯罪圈子里有极高声誉的弹药专家，他简直就是破坏的代名词。我们建议你携带比你所认为的致死量更高一级的火力来对付他。

你被授权使用任何必要的火力，枪炮刀剑都无所谓，把他干掉。

报酬将于合约成功完成后发放。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

8prhpu.description_en:
To help protect our pilots, Citizens for Prosperity will often recommend the use of less traditional routes through the system. However, it seems that a gang of outlaws has gotten word and has begun to stage repeated ambushes along one such flightpath. Rather than just go around the problem and risk it persisting along the new route, we feel it we be prudent to meet these outlaws head on.
You and whatever support ships you enlist will head to [LOCATION] and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.
Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
8prhpu.description_zh:
为保护我方飞行员，繁荣公民常建议采用星系内不那么传统的航线。然而，似乎一伙不法分子已获悉此事，并开始在其中一条航线上反复设伏。与其绕行避险、任其隐患蔓延至新路线，我们更倾向于正面迎击这些不法分子。

你及你召集来的支援飞船需要前往 [LOCATION]，清除所有埋伏于此的敌对势力。据知，他们惯以小股编队行动，因此务必确保全部敌人都已被歼灭后方可撤离。

非常感谢您的帮助，
利玛·恩迪科特

13ax19y.description_en:
Recently, a [TARGET] baited Foxwell forces with a bogus rescue beacon. By the time our forces realized what was happening, a squad of ships unleashed a devastating attack and only one Foxwell contractor survived. Their scan logs identified the bait ship, and we’ve had scouts monitoring them ever since.
Our surveillance has revealed the squad has a regular flight pattern that we think we can exploit. There’s a sizable emission cloud at [LOCATION] that makes it an ideal spot to post up. Think you have what it takes to handle this for us?
It’ll be you against the [TARGET], other large craft, and a sizable escort. Wish I could be more specific than that but this crew regularly rotates ships in and out of the squad. Would be smart to bring some support, so you don’t get overwhelmed by their numbers.
Complete the job and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 8 MG Scrip.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

10fd0mt.description_en:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx
DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.
While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.
Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.
TERMS*:
We are making available the exclusive mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to only you and your crew. Your team will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.
Please note that while we guarantee that these coordinates will be exclusive to you, we cannot assure that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may not discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
10fd0mt.description_zh:
合约：采矿权转让
地点：尼克斯星系

详情：
舒宾星际的勘探者们最近发现了一处已被废弃的 QV 行星服务公司碎岩站的位置，该站位于基格小行星带附近。这些站点最初由这家已倒闭的公司用来从小行星内部开采珍贵资源，但其确切位置早已丢失多年。

虽然该站点目前处于离线状态，但我们的侦察队认为，只要进行必要的维修，它就能重新投入使用。此外，一旦将其恢复运行，现场已经有一块富含资源的小行星，随时可以由站点的采矿激光进行开采。

不幸的是，由于在尼克斯运营面临的各种挑战，舒宾手头目前没有足够的宽裕自行处理上述维修工作。但这却为像您这样对独立采矿作业感兴趣的人创造了一个机会。

条款*: 
我们提供该 QV 碎岩站的独占采矿权。购买后，我们将仅向您及您的船员提供该站点的坐标。随后，您的船员可驾驶采矿飞船前往该地点，将该空间站的采矿激光恢复至运行状态，开采小行星，并在内部获取资源。

请注意，虽然我们保证这些坐标仅供您使用，但无法排除其他感兴趣的各方（如不法分子）自行发现该站点位置的可能性。请务必谨慎行事。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Putting out a call for a highly skilled pilot who can recover our client’s cargo. Please only accept this contract if you have experience dealing with extremely hostile situations involving multiple combatants. Additional crew members and a heavy-duty tractor beam are highly recommended.

· [LOCATION]

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Red Wind is excited to announce that we are looking to hire new couriers to help with deliveries across the ’verse. We pride ourselves on been a flexible company that’s eager to meet the needs of all clients, everywhere. We’ll ask no questions; if you want it there, we’ll get it there. If that sounds like you, we have an introductory contract to see if you’re the right fit.
We need a resilient new hire to head to [LOCATION], recover the package abandoned by a former employee, and finish the delivery.

If you’re able to handle this contract we’d be delighted to send you more courier opportunities.

你一到那儿就赶紧去阻止他们，别让他们造成永久性破坏。要是发现有友方飞船需要帮忙，你也得搭把手。别指望这帮家伙好对付，但只要你保持冷静，应该还是能摆平他们的。

要是你还缺点动力，那么我特意给主承包商额外加了 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

1wtaa00.description_en:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.
There's a real piece of work named [TARGET] who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When [TARGET] responded, they were very disrespectful.
We've tracked their ship to [LOCATION] and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.
Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.
Stows out.
1wtaa00.description_zh:
事情是这样的，猎头帮想要扩大他们的人才库，现在有几个职位空缺，欢迎任何有胆量的人来应征。

有个家伙名叫 [TARGETNAME]，觉得自己很聪明，从在星系中运输的货船那里偷走货物。我们要求他们支付一部分利润作为运营的许可税。当 [TARGETNAME] 回应时，他们非常无礼。

我们追踪到他们的飞船在 [LOCATION]，需要将他们解决掉。你应该知道，他们很聪明，知道紧靠一些盟友就不会孤立无援。

完成这个任务后，我们将考虑让你参与未来的猎头帮工作。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

242npf.description_en:
You’re almost through with the tutorial. All that remains is to take flight!
With your business in [LOCATION] finished, it’s time to leave the city – and eventually the planet. Make your way to the [TRANSITNAMESHORT] transit shuttles. These shuttles can take you all around [LOCATION] – but your destination is the spaceport, where an Anvil C8 Pisces has been temporarily provided for you.
This snub scouting ship is a great starter vessel, perfect for new pilots looking to get their wings.
242npf.description_zh:
您马上就要完成本教程了。接下来就该起飞了！

既然您已经处理完了 [LOCATION] 的事务，那么是时候离开城市了——接下来还会离开这颗星球。请前往 [TRANSITNAMESHORT] 乘坐穿梭机，这些穿梭机可以带您前往 [LOCATION] 各地。不过当前您的目的地是空港，在那里会有一艘铁砧航天的 C8 双鱼座临时供您使用。

这艘方正小巧的探索船是艘很棒的新手船，非常适合想要展翅高飞的新手驾驶员们使用。

wqxr50.description_en:
Hey again,
I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
wqxr50.description_zh:
嘿你好，

我有一个在 [LOCATION] 那的信标，这次的任务比平时复杂一些。有一支小型舰队请求补充 [FUELTYPE]。他们协调性好的出奇，计划性又差得离谱。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

所幸他们所在的区域安全一些，不太会有麻烦潜伏，但如今世事难料。还是尽快让他们恢复航行比较好。

一路顺风，

10o4kfs.description_en:
We've just received the location of an outlaw outpost where some up-and-coming criminals have been hanging out. Now, our client says there's no reason to engage these folks directly. Instead you will be targeting their supply lines.
Fly on over to [LOCATION] and take out their fuel stores while dealing with any minimal resistance they may put up. It will be your call on how much you engage with the hostile forces, just don't forget that your main objective is ensuring those fuel tanks are out of action.
This is a yellow level contract so pay will be proportionate.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
10o4kfs.description_zh:
我们刚收到一处不法分子前哨站的位置情报，据报一些初露头角的罪犯近期常在此出没。客户明确表示：无需正面交火，你的任务是切断他们的补给线。

请飞往 [LOCATION]，摧毁其燃料储备库，并应对可能出现的轻微抵抗。如何与敌对势力周旋由你自行判断，但切记，核心目标是确保那些燃料罐彻底瘫痪。

本任务为黄色级别合约，报酬将以此相应设定。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。
